title: Wrong GPS Location Cron
subtitle: Backend Design Document
author: Engineering

overview.problemStatement: Fleet customers are sometimes charged at toll plazas where the vehicle GPS location at reader time is far from the plaza. The Wrong GPS cron detects these mismatches, creates WRONG_GPS claim candidates in toll_rate_verify, and emails operational summaries so disputes can be raised.
assumptions: Only debit toll transactions (NETC_CORPORATE_DEBIT, DEEMED_ACCEPTANCE_DEBIT) with amount > 0 and a non-null RRN are eligible.
Customer must have gpsCheckingEnabled = 1 and the vehicle must be linked to an active vehicle_gps group with a non-empty API URL.
External GPS providers return success + lat/lon (lon or long) for the vehicle at txn reader time.
A mismatch is defined as Haversine distance > 10,000 meters (10 km) between toll plaza coordinates and GPS coordinates.
Data prepare looks at T-2 (Asia/Kolkata) so GPS provider history is available before validation.
WRONG_GPS claims feed the existing debit-adjustment / claim workflow via toll_rate_verify.transaction_type = WRONG_GPS.

columns.notes: Source vehicle_toll_history.id; skip if already staged

apis.purpose: List GPS groups (paginated/filterable) for admin/customer setup
List assignable vehicles for a customer when creating/editing a GPS group
Create GPS group (URL template, optional token, vehicleNos, status)
Update GPS group credentials and vehicle assignments
Stage T-2 debit txns into temp_gps_check_data

apis.route: Job 6 every 5 min (03:30, then 04:00–23:55 IST) → startGpsLocationCheck()
apis.purpose: Call GPS APIs, compute distance, insert/update WRONG_GPS in toll_rate_verify
Fallback email report for previous day + purge ~10-day-old temp rows
Send current-day report only if no pending GPS API rows remain

coreFlows.name: Data prepare (daily)
coreFlows.summary: Loads eligible toll debits for T-2 and stages them for the GPS worker.
steps: Select vehicle_toll_history for T-2 (IST) where txnType in NETC_CORPORATE_DEBIT / DEEMED_ACCEPTANCE_DEBIT, amount > 0, rrn not null
Require customer.gpsCheckingEnabled = 1 and vehicle → active vehicle_gps with non-empty URL
Skip if vehicle_toll_history_id already exists in temp_gps_check_data
Resolve/create/update toll lat-long from toll master (fallback to txn locationLat/Lang)
Insert temp_gps_check_data with gps_api_call_status = 1 and snapshotted API credentials
Email prepare summary (and Excel of failed inserts when any)

coreFlows.name: GPS location check worker
coreFlows.summary: Consumes pending temp rows, compares GPS vs plaza, and raises WRONG_GPS candidates.
steps: Every 5 minutes, load pending rows (status=1, gps_api_call_status in 0,1) in batches of 50, max 5 concurrent API calls
Replace {{vehicle_no}} / {{date_time}} in URL; call provider with token header when configured
Parse lat/lon from response; compute Haversine distance to toll coordinates
If distance ≤ 10 km → gps_verification_result = 1 (OK), no claim
If distance > 10 km → gps_verification_result = 2; create toll_rate_verify WRONG_GPS (or upgrade doubleDebit → WRONG_GPS; skip if already claimed otherwise)
When queue empties for the run, trigger sendGPSLocationCheckReport for current day

coreFlows.name: Email report & cleanup
coreFlows.summary: Operational visibility for API errors and failed claim inserts.
steps: Select temp rows for the report window with email_report_processed_at IS NULL
Mark each row status=0 and set email_report_processed_at
Count within-threshold / outside-threshold / API errors / toll_rate_verify insert failures
Attach Excel of exception rows and email via DAILY_RECONCILE_SERVICE email config
Delete temp_gps_check_data rows created around 10 days ago

coreLogic.title: Eligibility for prepare
coreLogic.description: A txn enters the queue only when it is a positive debit with RRN, customer GPS checking is enabled, and the vehicle is tied to an active GPS group with a usable API base URL. Blank URL on an otherwise active group is skipped (nothing useful to call later).

coreLogic.title: URL template substitution
coreLogic.description: Admin stores provider URL templates with {{vehicle_no}} and {{date_time}}. Worker substitutes vehicle number and txn_reader_time before GET. Optional header uses gps_api_token_name + gps_api_token (supports providers like KTT and Magiva).

coreLogic.title: 10 km distance rule
coreLogic.description: Distance is Haversine in meters. Threshold MAX_ALLOWED_DISTANCE_IN_METERS = 10000. Within threshold = valid location; beyond threshold = Wrong GPS candidate.

coreLogic.title: toll_rate_verify upsert rules
coreLogic.description: No existing row (or existing wrongReturn) → create WRONG_GPS with verificationPending and location_check_details. Existing doubleDebit → update type to WRONG_GPS and attach location details. Any other existing type → do not insert; record failure message on temp row.

coreLogic.title: Status semantics on temp_gps_check_data
coreLogic.description: gps_api_call_status: 0 not setup, 1 pending, 2 done. gps_verification_result: 0 error/config, 1 within threshold, 2 outside threshold. Report only emails exception-worthy rows (errors and failed claim inserts); successful within-threshold and successful claim inserts are counted but not listed.

validationRules: Prepare: txnType must be NETC_CORPORATE_DEBIT or DEEMED_ACCEPTANCE_DEBIT
Prepare: txnAmount > 0 and rrn IS NOT NULL
Prepare: vehicle must join active vehicle_gps (status=1) with non-empty gps_api_baseurl
Prepare: do not re-insert same vehicle_toll_history_id
Worker: reject invalid lat/long from toll master or GPS API (mark result 0)
Worker: provider response.success must be true to evaluate distance
Vehicle GPS API: groupName and gpsApiBaseurl required; status only 0 or 1; unique (customer_id, group_name)
Claim path: WRONG_GPS constant maps to claim type key 8 in constants
edgeCases: No pending temp rows → worker exits early; no report from that run
GPS API false/error/timeout → gps_verification_result=0, included in exception email
Toll lat/long missing → create/update toll from txn location; if still invalid numbers, skip claim
Provider returns long instead of lon → normalized before distance calc
RRN already in toll_rate_verify as non-doubleDebit/non-wrongReturn → claim not duplicated
doubleDebit already present → upgraded to WRONG_GPS with location details
Trigger report cron finds pending API rows → skips mail until queue drains
Prepare failures (validation/DB) → counted and attached as Excel to prepare notification
Temp retention: ~10-day-old created_at window deleted during report job
